queries.toponym_lane_weekly: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FROM external_place_candidates GROUP BY date_trunc('week', created_at) ORDER BY week
queries.plate_label_lane_weekly: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FROM external_region_candidates GROUP BY date_trunc('week', created_at) ORDER BY week
queries.candidate_decisions_by_source: SELECT c.source_id::text, COALESCE(src.title_ar, '') AS source_title, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'suggested') AS suggested, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'accepted') AS accepted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'corrected') AS corrected, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'rejected') AS rejected, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'deferred') AS deferred FROM external_region_candidates c LEFT JOIN sources src ON src.id = c.source_id GROUP BY c.source_id, src.title_ar ORDER BY total DESC
queries.pairing_decisions_by_source: SELECT c.source_id::text, COALESCE(src.title_ar, '') AS source_title, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('accepted', 'alias_only')) AS accepted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'rejected') AS rejected, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'deferred') AS deferred, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'suggested') AS suggested FROM external_place_candidates c LEFT JOIN sources src ON src.id = c.source_id GROUP BY c.source_id, src.title_ar ORDER BY total DESC
queries.transform_rms_distribution: SELECT c.plate_key, c.transform_rms_km, count(*) AS proposals, min(c.label_confidence) AS min_label_confidence, max(c.label_confidence) AS max_label_confidence FROM external_region_candidates c WHERE c.transform_rms_km IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.plate_key, c.transform_rms_km ORDER BY c.plate_key
queries.dira_coverage: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('accepted', 'corrected')) AS accepted_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.status IN ('accepted', 'corrected') AND c.region_geometry IS NOT NULL) AS accepted_with_geometry, COALESCE(sum(ST_Area(c.region_geometry::geography)) FILTER ( WHERE c.status IN ('accepted', 'corrected') AND c.region_geometry IS NOT NULL), 0) AS coverage_km2 FROM external_region_candidates c
queries.tile_states: SELECT status, count(*) FROM region_tile_tasks GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

definitions.acceptanceRate: (accepted + corrected) / decided rows; suggested rows are work remaining and sit in no rate
definitions.diraCoverage: the area of accepted candidates' traced region_geometry only; a label box is not an area, and no km² is derived from its centre
definitions.rms: the plate's recorded transform held-out RMS (030-D), the floor under every position the lane projects

candidate_decisions_by_source.source_title: خريطة قبائل الجزيرة العربية — هيئة الأركان البحريّة البريطانية ١٩١٦

dira_coverage.note: لا توجد مقترحات مقبولة تحمل شكل حدود بعد؛ كل صفوف المسار الأول صناديق ملصقات. التغطية صفر كم² منطوقة، ولا رقم يُصنع من مراكز الملصقات.
